name: UserMfaSettings
description: Per-user MFA enrollment (plan-62.B). One row per user (idOfUser). Holds whether the user opted into MFA, the allowed methods, and the phone for SMS OTP. Identity infra — reached only through the platform /api/v2.0/auth/mfa/* endpoints (AuthService, raised-privilege DataStore), never generic CRUD: dataApi is blocked.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: The user this MFA enrollment belongs to (User.id).

attributes.name: mfaEnabled
attributes.description: True when the user has opted into MFA. MFA is challenged at login when this is true OR the app's AppConfig.authMfaRequired is true.

attributes.name: methods
attributes.description: Comma-separated allowed OTP delivery methods for this user: email,sms. V1 has no TOTP.

attributes.name: phoneNumber
attributes.description: E.164 phone for SMS OTP. Falls back to User.mobilePhone when blank.

attributes.name: lastVerifiedAt
attributes.description: Epoch millis of the last successful MFA verification.
